meta.name: PhysAlts Domains, Subdomains & Open Materials
meta.description: Structured taxonomy of 8 major physics domains and 44 subdomains paired with vetted open courses, textbooks, datasets, archives, and global flagship experiments.

domains.name: Particle, Nuclear & High-Energy Physics
domains.desc: Fundamental constituents of matter, gauge interactions, neutrinos, dark matter, nuclear structure, and particle accelerators.

subdomains.name: Collider, Electroweak & Higgs Physics
subdomains.summary: Probing the 125 GeV Higgs boson, electroweak symmetry breaking, top quark, and beyond-Standard-Model signatures at TeV energy scales.
keyQuestions: What is the exact shape of the Higgs self-interaction potential?
Why is the electroweak scale 17 orders of magnitude lighter than the Planck scale?

materials.title: CERN Open Data Portal (LHC Collision Datasets)
Quantum Field Theory & Standard Model Lecture Notes

subdomains.name: Quantum Chromodynamics & Lattice QCD
subdomains.summary: Understanding color confinement, asymptotic freedom, hadron masses, and quark-gluon plasma through perturbation theory and supercomputer lattice simulations.
keyQuestions: How does color confinement emerge rigorously from the Yang-Mills mass gap?
How do quarks and gluons assemble the proton's spin and mass?

subdomains.name: Neutrino Physics & Oscillations
subdomains.summary: Measuring neutrino mass ordering, leptonic CP violation, Majorana versus Dirac nature, and astrophysical neutrinos from supernovae and blazars.
keyQuestions: Are neutrinos their own antiparticles (Majorana fermions)?
Did leptonic CP violation drive the matter-antimatter asymmetry of the universe?

materials.title: PDG Neutrino Masses, Mixing, and Oscillations Review
MIT 8.701 Introduction to Nuclear and Particle Physics

subdomains.name: Direct & Indirect Dark Matter Detection
subdomains.summary: Ultra-low-background underground xenon and cryogenic detectors, axion haloscopes, and cosmic-ray telescopes hunting non-baryonic dark matter.
keyQuestions: Is dark matter made of WIMPs, ultralight axions, sterile neutrinos, or primordial black holes?
How does dark matter couple to Standard Model particles beyond gravity?

materials.title: TASI & Perimeter Recorded Dark Matter Lectures

subdomains.name: Nuclear Structure, Rare Isotopes & Astrophysics
subdomains.summary: Exploring exotic neutron-rich nuclei, the r-process origin of heavy elements, nuclear equation of state in neutron stars, and superheavy elements.
keyQuestions: Where are the drip-line boundaries of nuclear stability and the island of superheavy elements?
How does dense nuclear matter behave inside merging neutron stars?

projects.name: FAIR (Facility for Antiproton and Ion Research)

subdomains.name: Accelerator & Plasma Wakefield Physics
subdomains.summary: Superconducting RF cavities, high-field magnets, muon collider cooling, and laser/beam-driven plasma wakefield acceleration.
keyQuestions: Can plasma wakefield accelerators shrink multi-kilometer colliders to tabletop scales?
Can intense short-lived muon beams be cooled rapidly enough for a 10 TeV collider?

domains.name: Quantum Science, AMO & Photonics
domains.desc: Quantum information processing, trapped atoms and ions, attosecond lasers, quantum optics, EUV photonics, and quantum networks.

subdomains.name: Quantum Computing & Fault-Tolerant Error Correction
subdomains.summary: Superconducting qubits, trapped ions, neutral-atom tweezers, silicon spin qubits, photonic architectures, and surface/qLDPC error correction.
keyQuestions: How many physical qubits and what gate fidelities are needed for utility-scale fault tolerance?
Which quantum algorithms deliver provable exponential advantage in chemistry and materials?

materials.title: John Preskill's Quantum Computation Lecture Notes (Ph219)

subdomains.name: Quantum Optics, Entanglement & Cavity QED
subdomains.summary: Nonclassical states of light, Bell inequality tests, squeezed states for metrology, and strong light-matter coupling in cavities and circuits.
keyQuestions: How can squeezed and entangled states push interferometers past the standard quantum limit?
Where is the boundary between macroscopic quantum superposition and decoherence?

materials.title: Feynman Lectures on Physics Vol. III (Quantum Mechanics)

projects.name: Munich Center for Quantum Science and Technology (MCQST)

subdomains.name: Ultracold Atoms, BECs & Optical Lattice Clocks
subdomains.summary: Laser-cooled nanokelvin gases, optical-lattice quantum simulators, atom interferometers, and optical clocks accurate to 1 second in the age of the universe.
keyQuestions: Can nuclear-transition thorium-229 clocks detect tiny drifts in fundamental constants?
Can optical-clock geodesy measure gravitational redshift across millimeter height changes?

materials.title: MIT 8.421 Atomic and Optical Physics I

subdomains.name: Attosecond & High-Intensity Laser Physics
subdomains.summary: High-harmonic generation producing 10⁻¹⁸-second light bursts to film electron motion inside atoms and petawatt lasers probing strong-field QED.
keyQuestions: How fast does photoionization and charge migration unfold in molecules?
Can multi-petawatt lasers create electron-positron pairs directly from the quantum vacuum?

materials.title: 2023 Nobel Prize in Physics Scientific Background (Attosecond Pulses)
Laboratory for Attosecond Physics Educational Resources

subdomains.name: Nanophotonics, Metamaterials & EUV Optics
subdomains.summary: Photonic crystals, topological photonics, integrated silicon photonics, and extreme ultraviolet plasma-driven Bragg mirror optics.
keyQuestions: How can integrated photonic chips replace copper interconnects for ultra-low-energy AI and quantum computing?
What physical limits govern sub-nanometer optical lithography?

materials.title: MEEP Open-Source FDTD Photonics & Photonic Crystals Documentation

projects.name: ARCNL Advanced Research Center for Nanolithography

subdomains.name: Quantum Communication & Quantum Internet
subdomains.summary: Entanglement distribution over optical fibers and satellites, quantum repeaters, quantum key distribution (QKD), and distributed quantum sensing.
keyQuestions: How can quantum memories and repeaters extend entanglement across continents?
Can entangled space-based clock networks achieve unprecedented global synchronization?

materials.title: QuTech Academy Open Quantum Internet Courses

domains.name: Astrophysics & Cosmology
domains.desc: Cosmic evolution, dark energy, the Cosmic Microwave Background, black holes, exoplanets, and multi-wavelength sky surveys.

subdomains.name: Observational Cosmology & Dark Energy
subdomains.summary: Mapping baryon acoustic oscillations, galaxy clustering, weak lensing, and Type Ia supernovae to test whether dark energy evolves over cosmic time.
keyQuestions: Is the Hubble tension a systematic measurement discrepancy or evidence for new early-universe physics?
Does dark energy evolve dynamically rather than remaining Einstein's cosmological constant?

materials.title: Sloan Digital Sky Survey (SDSS) Open Data

subdomains.name: Cosmic Microwave Background & Early Universe
subdomains.summary: Precision temperature and B-mode polarization maps of the 380,000-year-old universe hunting primordial gravitational waves from cosmic inflation.
keyQuestions: At what energy scale did cosmic inflation occur, and what is the tensor-to-scalar ratio r?
What do CMB lensing maps reveal about the sum of neutrino masses?

materials.title: LAMBDA Cosmic Microwave Background Data Center

subdomains.name: Exoplanets & Planetary Formation
subdomains.summary: Radial velocity, transit spectroscopy, microlensing, and direct coronagraphic imaging characterizing rocky worlds and protoplanetary disks.
keyQuestions: How common are temperate rocky planets with stable atmospheres around Sun-like and M-dwarf stars?
What spectroscopic signatures unambiguously indicate biological activity?

materials.title: MIT 12.425 Extrasolar Planets: Physics and Detection Techniques

subdomains.name: High-Energy & Multimessenger Astrophysics
subdomains.summary: Uniting gamma rays, X-rays, ultra-high-energy cosmic rays, neutrinos, and gravitational waves to decipher supernovae, kilonovae, and active galactic nuclei.
keyQuestions: Which cosmic accelerators boost protons and nuclei past 10²⁰ eV?
How do relativistic blazar jets launch and accelerate particles?

materials.title: Pierre Auger Observatory Open Data Portal

subdomains.name: Black Holes, Relativistic Jets & Horizon Imaging
subdomains.summary: Very-long-baseline millimeter interferometry, X-ray reverberation, and stellar-orbit tracking around supermassive and stellar black holes.
keyQuestions: How did billion-solar-mass supermassive black holes grow within 500 million years of the Big Bang?
How does the Blandford-Znajek mechanism extract rotational energy from spinning horizons?

materials.title: Event Horizon Telescope Open Data Products
NASA HEASARC High Energy Astrophysics Archive

subdomains.name: Radio Astronomy, Pulsars & 21-cm Cosmology
subdomains.summary: Using giant radio arrays to time millisecond pulsars, unravel Fast Radio Bursts (FRBs), and map neutral hydrogen during the Cosmic Dawn.
keyQuestions: What physical engines power repeating and non-repeating Fast Radio Bursts?
When did the first stars and galaxies reionize the intergalactic hydrogen fog?

materials.title: NRAO Essential Radio Astronomy Open Textbook

domains.name: Gravitational Waves, Relativity & Fundamental Theory
domains.desc: Spacetime geometry, laser interferometers, numerical relativity, quantum gravity, holography, and mathematical physics.

subdomains.name: Gravitational-Wave Interferometry & Pulsar Timing
subdomains.summary: Laser interferometers on Earth and in space plus pulsar timing arrays measuring sub-proton spacetime strains across 12 decades of frequency.
keyQuestions: Is the nanohertz gravitational-wave background sourced by supermassive black hole binaries or early-universe physics?
Do black hole ringdown quasi-normal modes obey the Kerr no-hair theorem exactly?

subdomains.name: General Relativity & Numerical Relativity
subdomains.summary: Solving Einstein's nonlinear partial differential equations on supercomputers to model colliding black holes, neutron star mergers, and extreme curvature.
keyQuestions: Does cosmic censorship hold universally for generic gravitational collapse?
How accurately can waveform models track eccentric and high-spin binary mergers?

materials.title: Sean Carroll's Lecture Notes on General Relativity (arXiv:gr-qc/9712019)
Einstein Toolkit Open-Source Numerical Relativity Software

subdomains.name: String Theory, Holography & AdS/CFT
subdomains.summary: Unifying quantum gravity with gauge fields through string dynamics, gauge/gravity duality, black hole entropy microstates, and entanglement wedges.
keyQuestions: How is quantum information preserved during black hole Hawking evaporation (the Page curve)?
How does holographic duality extend from Anti-de Sitter space to our expanding de Sitter cosmos?

projects.name: Simons Collaboration on It from Qubit / Quantum Gravity

subdomains.name: Loop Quantum Gravity & Discrete Quantum Spacetime
subdomains.summary: Background-independent quantization of geometry via spin networks, spin foams, causal dynamical triangulations, and quantum cosmology bounces.
keyQuestions: Is spacetime quantized into discrete Planck-scale areas and volumes?
Does quantum geometry resolve the Big Bang and black hole interior singularities?

materials.title: arXiv General Relativity and Quantum Cosmology (gr-qc)
Perimeter Institute Recorded Quantum Gravity Courses

subdomains.name: Mathematical Physics, Symmetries & Amplitudes
subdomains.summary: Noether symmetries, differential geometry, conformal bootstrap, scattering amplitudes, and non-perturbative quantum field theory.
keyQuestions: Can scattering amplitudes be derived purely from geometric principles without local spacetime Lagrangians?
Can a rigorous mathematical proof of 4D Yang-Mills existence and mass gap be achieved?

materials.title: Gerard 't Hooft's How to Become a Good Theoretical Physicist

projects.name: Simons Collaboration on the Nonperturbative Bootstrap

domains.name: Fusion Energy & Plasma Physics
domains.desc: Magnetic and inertial confinement fusion, superconducting magnets, burning-plasma stability, and astrophysical plasmas.

subdomains.name: Magnetic Confinement Tokamaks
subdomains.summary: Toroidal magnetic bottles confining 150-million-kelvin deuterium-tritium plasma while managing divertor heat exhaust, disruptions, and tritium breeding.
keyQuestions: How can edge-localized modes (ELMs) and disruptions be reliably prevented in burning plasmas?
Can breeding blankets maintain tritium self-sufficiency at commercial plant scale?

materials.title: ITER Science & Fusion Energy Educational Portal
MIT 22.611J Introduction to Plasma Physics I

subdomains.name: Stellarators & 3D Magnetic Optimization
subdomains.summary: Disruption-free, intrinsically steady-state twisted 3D magnetic cages designed via quasi-symmetry and supercomputer coil optimization.
keyQuestions: Can quasi-isodynamic and quasi-axisymmetric stellarators match or exceed tokamak confinement without plasma currents?
How can complex 3D HTS stellarator coils be manufactured economically?

materials.title: Max Planck IPP Wendelstein 7-X Science Portal
materials.provider: Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics

subdomains.name: Inertial Confinement & High-Energy-Density Physics
subdomains.summary: Compressing millimeter fuel capsules with megajoule laser pulses or pulsed-power Z-pinches to ignite fusion before inertia lets the fuel expand.
keyQuestions: How can laser wall-plug efficiency and target repetition rate reach 10 Hz for inertial fusion energy?
How do hydrodynamic Rayleigh-Taylor instabilities affect capsule implosion symmetry?

materials.title: NIF Fusion Ignition & HED Science Portal

subdomains.name: High-Temperature Superconducting Fusion Magnets
subdomains.summary: Engineering 20-tesla REBCO rare-earth barium copper oxide coils that shrink magnetic fusion volume by an order of magnitude (fusion power scales as B⁴).
keyQuestions: How do REBCO tapes survive decades of intense 14.1 MeV fusion neutron irradiation?
Can demountable HTS joints simplify fusion reactor maintenance?

projects.name: SPARC Toroidal Field Model Coil & Magnet Suite

subdomains.name: Solar, Heliospheric & Astrophysical Plasmas
subdomains.summary: Magnetic reconnection, solar coronal heating, Alfvén turbulence, planetary magnetospheres, and cosmic-ray shock acceleration.
keyQuestions: What exact kinetic mechanisms heat the solar corona to millions of kelvin above a 5,800 K surface?
How does collisionless magnetic reconnection explosively convert magnetic energy into particle kinetic energy?

domains.name: Condensed Matter, Materials & Statistical Physics
domains.desc: Emergent quantum phases of matter, superconductivity, topological materials, 2D systems, synchrotrons, neutrons, and statistical mechanics.

subdomains.name: Unconventional & High-Tc Superconductivity
subdomains.summary: Cuprates, iron pnictides, nickelates, heavy fermions, and high-pressure hydrides exhibiting zero resistance beyond conventional BCS electron-phonon pairing.
keyQuestions: What pairing mechanism drives cuprate superconductivity above 130 K?
Can a stable ambient-pressure room-temperature superconductor exist?

subdomains.name: Topological Insulators, Anyons & Quantum Hall Physics
subdomains.summary: Bulk-boundary correspondence, Chern insulators, Weyl semimetals, fractional quantum Hall quasiparticles, and non-Abelian Majorana zero modes.
keyQuestions: Can non-Abelian anyons be braided reliably to build intrinsically protected topological qubits?
How do strong electron correlations and band topology intertwine in fractional Chern insulators?

projects.name: ETH / Delft / Microsoft & Academic Topological Matter Consortia

subdomains.name: 2D Materials & Moiré Twistronics
subdomains.summary: Atomically thin graphene, transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), and magic-angle twisted bilayers hosting tunable flat bands and correlated phases.
keyQuestions: How can moiré superlattices act as solid-state quantum simulators for the Hubbard model?
Can van der Waals heterostructures yield ultra-low-power room-temperature quantum electronics?

materials.title: 2010 Nobel Prize in Physics Scientific Background (Graphene)

subdomains.name: Quantum Magnetism, Spin Liquids & Spintronics
subdomains.summary: Frustrated magnets, Kitaev quantum spin liquids, magnetic skyrmions, altermagnets, and spin-orbit torque memory devices.
keyQuestions: Which real crystal compounds realize unambiguous quantum spin-liquid ground states?
How fast can terahertz antiferromagnetic and altermagnetic spintronics switch?

keyQuestions: How do light-induced metastable quantum phases evolve on femtosecond timescales?
How can operando X-ray and neutron imaging guide solid-state batteries and catalysts?

subdomains.name: Statistical Mechanics, Phase Transitions & Complex Systems
subdomains.summary: Renormalization group, non-equilibrium thermodynamics, active matter, glasses, spin glasses, and network dynamics.
keyQuestions: What general variational principles govern far-from-equilibrium active and living systems?
Is the glass transition a true thermodynamic phase transition or purely dynamical arrest?

subdomains.name: Biophysics & Soft Condensed Matter
subdomains.summary: Molecular motors, protein folding energetics, liquid-liquid phase separation in cells, polymers, membranes, and neural dynamics.
keyQuestions: How do cellular assemblies harness non-equilibrium statistical physics to self-organize and copy information accurately?
How do physical forces govern embryonic morphogenesis?

subdomains.name: Atmospheric, Climate & Planetary Geophysics
subdomains.summary: Radiative transfer, geophysical fluid dynamics, ocean-atmosphere coupling, seismology, and planetary dynamo physics.
keyQuestions: How do cloud microphysics and polar ice-sheet mechanics control equilibrium climate sensitivity?
How do deep-mantle convection and core-mantle dynamics drive geomagnetic reversals?

subdomains.name: Medical Physics, Imaging & Hadron Therapy

keyQuestions: Why does ultra-fast FLASH radiotherapy spare healthy tissue while destroying tumors?
Can compact laser-plasma accelerators make hadron therapy globally accessible?

How sensitive can quantum magnetometers and gravimeters become in field environments?
